method: Each definition in s20-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its whole test file run with the vitest JSON reporter, every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the whole file rerun. A proof needs the named row to fail on an AssertionError, a byte-identical restore and an all-passing rerun; other failing rows are recorded. The unit file tests/unit/buyer-agent.test.ts drives clients/buyer-agent with Envoi's API faked at the generated client's fetch boundary by tests/support/fake-envoi-api.ts and OpenAI faked at the provider's fetch boundary by tests/support/fake-openai.ts, both labeled FIXTURE, so no deployment or model is called. Every definition here is an S20 test recorded in 00-status.md.
